_comment: FRIDAY reflection goal. Defines success / failure / quality bar. Trades are scored against this. Edit by hand any time; the engine never rewrites this file.

_notes.target_return_30d: 0.50 = +50% in 30 days. Operator-set. Effectively unreachable at min_sharpe 2.0 — the failure floors below are the brakes that stop the loop chasing it into reckless territory.
_notes.failure_below_return: If projected 30d return drops below this, the composite score is forced steeply negative regardless of other factors.
_notes.failure_below_score: Below this composite score, the engine is forbidden from increasing risk. It may only de-risk or enforce discipline.
_notes.account_equity_base: Denominator for return/drawdown. Auto-updated from MT5 balance when a live demo connection is available; otherwise this static value is used.
